The Committee shall study possible changes to existing tax laws that will comply
with the objectives of this Executive Order, and recommend the same for their
passage into law.

Consultation with Relevant Sectors; Creation' of Sub-Committees. ln
arriving at its recornmendations, the Committee shall take all efforts to consult
with those sectors of the public that will be affected by the proposed changes to the
tax laws. To facilitate its work the Cornmittee may create technical-working
committees, as well as a secretariat.

Committee Report. Within ninety (90) days from the effectivity of this
order, the Committee shall report to this Office and to the Ways ancl Means
Committees of the Senate and of the House of Representatives the progress of its
efforts, submitting, ifpossible, a draft of its recornmended legislation.

Repe.aling Clause, All executive orders, adminishative orders, and
other Executive issuances, including memorandum orders of the DOF, BIR and
NTRC inconsistent herewith arJ hereby repealed, modified, or amended
accordingly.
